pdf.js 6.3.289 (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE), self-hosted so the site makes no request outside its own origin. This is the legacy build: the same version, with polyfills for older browsers.

Both files are byte-identical to the ones in the npm package named below. The tarball was fetched on 2026-11-05 with `npm pack pdfjs-dist@6.3.289 --ignore-scripts` into an empty folder
outside the repository and extracted as data (nothing from it was run); its sha512 matched the registry's dist.integrity. The modern build this replaced was byte-identical to the same package.
To update: pack the new version the same way, copy legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs, rewrite this note, run node scripts/vendor-manifest.mjs, npm test and npm run test:browser.
